title: Mixed Event — Warmth in Every Stitch — Episode5 Grandma's Treasure

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku feels grateful for all of Mafuyu's help with studying and club activities, and wants to do something in return. When she learns that Mafuyu is looking for ways to improve her home ec project, she offers some embroidery lessons.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to meet with us today, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No problem.
I mean, I already promised Shizuku that I'd help her come up with embroidery designs.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, I wanna help you two with your gifts and make sure they turn out really well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Then, let's start by coming up with a design for MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well... In my mind, MEIKO likes to train and work out...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Embroidering that sounds kinda hard...
What if you based your design on her powerful and sunny singing voice instead?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's an excellent idea...!
How about a microphone on a stand with little notes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize you two were here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
What should we do?! MEIKO's going to find out...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
MEIKO, KAITO was just looking for you!
He wanted to make some changes to his workout routine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Really? I'll go find him now!
Thank you, Len!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Alright, these effects look good♪
Next, I'll...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Sorry, I need to log off early today.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay, that's fine.
Do you have some homework assignments left?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, do you have to get up early for something tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I mean, even Yuki can want to leave early every now and again, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<So, Yuki, have fun!
We'll see you again tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, your candle embroidery seems to be coming along nicely.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I should be finished with it after I use some long and short stitches to make the flame.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're going to use different colors to create a gradation, yes? That's always a bit tricky, so please feel free to ask me for help if you feel you need it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You really love to embroider, don't you, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Why do you say that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Based on the way you're humming.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, was I humming just now? I guess I couldn't help it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I do like embroidery itself...
But it's the time spent like this that I really love.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This slow, relaxed time thinking of another, putting my feelings for them into form.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I remember telling you how I believe a lot of emotion goes into every stitch...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And that's also a result of the time we spend.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
These are the things you think about while embroidering.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, these are all things that my grandmother taught me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, so... The truth is, I've always been a grandma's girl.
Chiefly because my parents were away so much when Shii and I were little. She looked after us while they were gone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She taught me how to do quite a few of her many hobbies, and embroidery was one of them.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Go...!
Yes, I got my bamboo-copter to fly!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Hehe. This is so much fun!
We get to play all these traditional games together!)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, she's practicing how to use the spinning tops. She seems really focused right now, so I should probably try something else...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Grandma's sewing over there.
I wonder what she's making...)

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: New clothes for you and Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Yes, I was just embroidering some flowers into the collars.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow, look at all the little flowers! They're so adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Can I watch you while you work on these, Grandma?

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Of course. Just be careful not to get poked by my needle.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: (Grandma has such a big smile on her face...)

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Hm? You seem to be in an awfully good mood, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That's because you have a really big smile on your face!

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Really? The joy I'm feeling must be overflowing.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: After all, I treasure every minute that I spend embroidering.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Yes. With each stitch, I think about what kind of embroidery would look good on you, and I hope it will make you happy.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: So, this time is very precious to me.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Hehe. If you're interested, Shizuku, would you like to embroider with me?

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, I want to give it a try...!
